text: EN-EZ İnşaat, Fenerbahce basketball's shorts-side sponsor, was founded in 2002 and, per the placement announcement, put its logo on the left side of the club's shorts from the 2025/26 season. The announcement does not name the company's owners; they were not found in this pass.
short: EN-EZ İnşaat is a Turkish construction company founded in 2002.

source.name: Turkspor Ajansi - Fenerbahce, Beko'ya iki yeni sponsor
